verdict.rationale: Relay's docs say you can define roles for card issuance and give team members and financial advisors secure, role-based banking access. Approval delegation is covered by multi-step approval rules and payment approvals. There is no evidence of granular permission scoping by location or department, and the role model is described only in one-line marketing claims; the 'issues with permissions' in Trustpilot reviews are minor, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: per-location and per-department permission scoping, detailed documentation of role definitions and granularity, independent hands-on corroboration.
